The attached full-body V3 is the character identity and body-proportion authority. Canvas SQUARE 2048x2048 preferred (minimum 1024x1024), precisely two columns and two rows, four equal independent square cells. The wide square cells are necessary to leave room for extended limbs. Leave at least 6% completely transparent padding on every side of EACH cell. Each cell is a single full-body figure with clear transparent margins, no touching/overlap between cells, no cropped helmet fins, hands or boots. Keep that gripping hand fully readable and leave ample space where the blade will be. No floating blade or leftover weapon fragment. No shield.
Actual articulated animation: change torso rotation, shoulder, elbow, wrist, pelvis, knees and feet according to the frame directions below; do not repeat a static pose with image shifts. Maintain exactly two arms, two legs and coherent hands, accurate mechanical joints and armor panel identity.
No text, labels, numerals, grid lines, floor, background, contact shadow, glow aura, smoke, decorative FX or opaque black/white matte. Only four clean character bodies on true transparent alpha. The ordered four frames are:
USER CORRECTION FOR EVERY FRAME: keep the neck compact, helmet seated in the collar with no long thin exposed neck. Match the corrected idle reference's slightly shorter neck. Use a firm anatomical power grip around the short handle: four armored fingers wrapped, thumb closing across index side, wrist aligned to forearm, not pinching or floating. Preserve the corrected reference's tall physical stature and compact head.
